name: Index YouTube Playlist

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  index-youtube:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: index-youtube
      cancel-in-progress: true
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run YouTube indexing
        env:
          YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
          YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID }}
          CLOUDFLARE_VECTORIZE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_VECTORIZE_API_KEY }}
          CLOUDFLARE_VECTORIZE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_VECTORIZE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          CLOUDFLARE_VECTORIZE_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_VECTORIZE_PROJECT_ID }}
          CLOUDFLARE_R2_BUCKET: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_R2_BUCKET }}
          CLOUDFLARE_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          CLOUDFLARE_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          CLOUDFLARE_R2_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_R2_ENDPOINT }}
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096
        run: npm run index-youtube
